fragments.title: Prompt base
fragments.text: You are editing an architectural render produced by Colomer-Rifà, an architecture and engineering firm. Improve the visual quality of the provided base image so it reads as a professional, photorealistic architectural photograph, while keeping the project exactly as designed. The base image is the single source of truth: preserve the building geometry and volumes, every window, door, pillar, canopy, access, roof and façade module, the urban layout (roads, kerbs, sidewalks, parking bays and plots), the camera position, focal length, perspective and framing, and every logo, sign and lettering. Logos and signage of Bonpreu, Esclat, Esclat Oil, Cupra and SEAT are untouchable: never redraw, restyle, move, resize, translate or regenerate them. Do not add, remove or move architectural elements, people, vehicles, text or watermarks unless explicitly requested below.

fragments.title: Comercial / supermercat
fragments.text: Project type: retail building (supermarket or commercial unit). Favour a clean, welcoming and well-maintained commercial atmosphere, legible shopfronts and realistic car-park surfaces.

fragments.title: Industrial / logística
fragments.text: Project type: industrial or logistics building. Favour a sober, functional atmosphere with crisp cladding panels, realistic loading areas and well-defined hard landscaping.

fragments.title: Residencial
fragments.text: Project type: residential building. Favour a calm, liveable atmosphere with natural light, believable domestic details behind the glazing and soft landscaping.

fragments.title: Equipament públic
fragments.text: Project type: public facility. Favour a civic, open and accessible atmosphere with durable materials and clear pedestrian spaces.

fragments.title: Oficines
fragments.text: Project type: office building. Favour a contemporary, professional atmosphere with precise curtain walls and orderly exterior spaces.

fragments.title: Estació de servei
fragments.text: Project type: fuel or service station. Keep canopy, pumps, price totems and forecourt markings exactly as designed and render them with clean, realistic finishes.

fragments.title: Concessionari de vehicles
fragments.text: Project type: car dealership. Keep the brand portal, showroom glazing and display areas exactly as designed, with high-quality reflections and spotless surfaces.

fragments.title: Altres / no detectada
fragments.text: Project type: architectural project. Apply a neutral, professional architectural photography style.

fragments.title: Fotorealisme general
fragments.text: Improve overall photorealism: physically plausible light, soft and coherent shadows, ambient occlusion, accurate reflections and fine surface textures, as in a high-end architectural photograph.

fragments.title: Vegetació
fragments.text: Improve the vegetation according to the vegetation instructions below.

fragments.title: Vidres
fragments.text: Improve the glazing according to the glass instructions below.

fragments.title: Materials
fragments.text: Improve how the existing materials are rendered according to the material instructions below, without changing any material, colour or finish choice.

fragments.title: Il·luminació
fragments.text: Adjust the lighting according to the lighting instructions below, keeping shadows consistent with a single sun or sky source.

fragments.title: Entorn
fragments.text: Improve the surroundings according to the environment instructions below. The surroundings are context only and must never become more prominent than the project.

fragments.title: Interiors visibles
fragments.text: Make the interiors visible through the glazing believable: subtle depth, soft interior lighting and plausible, uncluttered furnishing that matches the building use, without adding text, logos or people.

fragments.title: Resolució i nitidesa
fragments.text: Increase perceived resolution and sharpness: crisp edges, clean fine details and no noise, halos, oversharpening or compression artefacts.

fragments.title: Mantenir original
fragments.text: Keep the existing vegetation exactly as it is: same species, positions, sizes and density.

fragments.title: Millorar existent
fragments.text: Make the existing vegetation photorealistic: natural foliage, realistic trunks and branches, varied leaf tones and natural light through the canopy, keeping every plant in its current position and size.

fragments.title: Arbres
fragments.text: Improve the existing trees: realistic trunks and branching, natural crown shapes and depth in the foliage, keeping their positions, heights and number.

fragments.title: Arbustos
fragments.text: Improve the existing shrubs and planters: natural volume, varied leaves and clean planter edges, keeping their positions and footprint.

fragments.title: Gespa
fragments.text: Improve the existing lawns: natural, slightly irregular grass with subtle colour variation and no repetitive tiling pattern, keeping the lawn boundaries unchanged.

fragments.title: Vegetació de fons
fragments.text: Improve the background vegetation so it adds depth: softer, less detailed and slightly hazier than the foreground, never competing with the building.

fragments.title: Mediterrània
fragments.text: Vegetation style: Mediterranean, using species such as olive trees, holm oaks, stone pines, lavender, rosemary and drought-tolerant grasses.

fragments.title: Urbana
fragments.text: Vegetation style: urban, using street trees such as plane trees, hackberries and lindens in tree pits, with neat, low-maintenance planting.

fragments.title: Industrial
fragments.text: Vegetation style: industrial, using sparse, robust and low-maintenance planting with gravel areas, hardy shrubs and a few well-spaced trees.

fragments.title: Residencial
fragments.text: Vegetation style: residential, using gardens with mixed shrubs, flowering plants, hedges and well-kept lawns.

fragments.title: Natural
fragments.text: Vegetation style: natural, using native species of Central Catalonia (holm oaks, oaks, pines, boxwood) with a wild, unmanicured look.

fragments.title: Mantenir estil original
fragments.text: Keep the current vegetation style and species.

fragments.title: Qualitat
fragments.text: From the vegetation reference, take only the level of realism and detail of the plants.

fragments.title: Tipus de fullatge
fragments.text: From the vegetation reference, take only the type of foliage (leaf shape and texture).

fragments.title: Densitat
fragments.text: From the vegetation reference, take only how dense the planting is, applied to the existing planted areas.

fragments.title: Color
fragments.text: From the vegetation reference, take only the colour palette of the plants.

fragments.title: Naturalitat
fragments.text: From the vegetation reference, take only how natural and irregular the plants look.

fragments.title: Estil general
fragments.text: From the vegetation reference, take only the overall planting style, never its layout or composition.

fragments.title: Mantenir originals
fragments.text: Keep the glazing exactly as it is: same tint, transparency and reflections.

fragments.title: Lleugerament més foscos
fragments.text: Make the glazing slightly darker with a subtle tint, keeping reflections and mullions intact.

fragments.title: Més foscos
fragments.text: Make the glazing noticeably darker, as solar-control glass, keeping mullions and frames clearly visible.

fragments.title: Més transparents
fragments.text: Make the glazing more transparent so the interior is partly visible, with soft and plausible interior light.

fragments.title: Més reflectants
fragments.text: Make the glazing more reflective, showing a coherent reflection of the sky and surroundings consistent with the camera position.

fragments.title: Vidre més neutre
fragments.text: Make the glazing colour-neutral, removing any blue or green cast while keeping natural reflections.

fragments.title: Mantenir original
fragments.text: Keep the original lighting: same time of day, sun direction and shadow length.

fragments.title: Matí
fragments.text: Lighting: clear morning, soft and slightly cool sunlight from a low angle with long, gentle shadows.

fragments.title: Migdia
fragments.text: Lighting: midday, bright and neutral sunlight from a high angle with short, crisp shadows.

fragments.title: 16:00 h
fragments.text: Lighting: around 4 pm, warm but still bright sunlight from a medium-low angle with defined shadows.

fragments.title: Hora daurada
fragments.text: Lighting: golden hour, warm low sunlight with long shadows and a soft glow on the façades.

fragments.title: Capvespre
fragments.text: Lighting: dusk, the sun just below the horizon, warm sky gradient, interior and exterior lights starting to turn on.

fragments.title: Hora blava
fragments.text: Lighting: blue hour, deep blue sky, interior lights clearly on and warm, exterior lighting balanced with the sky.

fragments.title: Nit
fragments.text: Lighting: night, dark sky, the building lit by its own interior and exterior lighting only, with realistic light falloff and no light pollution haze.

fragments.title: Mantenir originals
fragments.text: Keep every material exactly as it is.

fragments.title: Més detall
fragments.text: Add fine, realistic detail to the existing materials: joints, subtle imperfections and micro-texture at the correct scale.

fragments.title: Més rugositat
fragments.text: Increase the surface roughness of the existing materials where appropriate, reducing a plastic or CGI look.

fragments.title: Menys brillant
fragments.text: Reduce excessive gloss and specular highlights on opaque materials, keeping glass and metal reflections natural.

fragments.title: Més natural
fragments.text: Make the existing materials look more natural, with slight weathering and tonal variation consistent with a recently finished building.

fragments.title: Millorar fusta
fragments.text: Improve the existing wood: realistic grain, natural tone variation and correct board or slat scale, without changing its colour or orientation.

fragments.title: Millorar formigó
fragments.text: Improve the existing concrete: realistic formwork marks, tie holes where already present and subtle tonal variation, without changing its colour.

fragments.title: Millorar metall
fragments.text: Improve the existing metal: accurate panel joints, realistic reflections and a correct anodised or painted finish, without changing its colour.

fragments.title: Millorar paviment
fragments.text: Improve the existing paving: realistic joints, texture and subtle wear, keeping its pattern, colours and layout.

fragments.title: Mantenir original
fragments.text: Keep the surroundings exactly as they are.

fragments.title: Millorar paviment
fragments.text: Improve the texture of the existing exterior paving, keeping its layout and joints pattern.

fragments.title: Millorar voreres
fragments.text: Improve the texture of the existing sidewalks and kerbs, keeping their exact position and width.

fragments.title: Millorar asfalt
fragments.text: Improve the existing asphalt with realistic texture and subtle wear, keeping all road markings and parking lines exactly where they are.

fragments.title: Millorar mobiliari urbà existent
fragments.text: Improve the existing street furniture (benches, bollards, lamp posts, bins) with realistic materials, without adding, removing or moving any piece.

fragments.title: Millorar edificis de fons
fragments.text: Improve the realism of the existing background buildings, keeping their volumes and positions and keeping them visually secondary.

fragments.title: Millorar cel
fragments.text: Replace a flat or artificial sky with a realistic sky that matches the chosen lighting, without changing the horizon line.

fragments.title: Millorar profunditat atmosfèrica
fragments.text: Add subtle atmospheric perspective: distant elements slightly hazier and less saturated, improving depth.

fragments.title: Màxima fidelitat
fragments.text: Fidelity level: maximum. Apply only the improvements listed above. If any improvement could alter architecture, logos, materials or composition, do not apply it. When in doubt, leave the original pixels untouched.

fragments.title: Fidelitat + canvis seleccionats
fragments.text: Fidelity level: high. Keep everything from the original except what is explicitly requested above.

fragments.title: Creatiu controlat
fragments.text: Fidelity level: controlled creativity. Allow slightly more visual freedom only within the requested categories; the main architecture, camera, materials and logos remain unchanged.

fragments.title: Marc de les referències
fragments.text: Reference images are attached as visual guides only. Never copy their architecture, composition, camera, people, vehicles, text or logos into the base image.

fragments.title: Vegetació
fragments.text: This reference applies only to the vegetation.

fragments.title: Materials
fragments.text: This reference applies only to how materials are rendered.

fragments.title: Il·luminació
fragments.text: This reference applies only to the lighting and mood.

fragments.title: Entorn
fragments.text: This reference applies only to the surroundings.

fragments.title: Interior
fragments.text: This reference applies only to the interiors visible through the glazing.

fragments.title: Altra perspectiva
fragments.text: This reference is another view of the same project: use it only to understand the design, never to change the camera of the base image.

fragments.title: Qualitat
fragments.text: Take its level of realism.

fragments.title: Color

fragments.title: Textura
fragments.text: Take its textures.

fragments.title: Ambient

fragments.title: Tipus

fragments.title: Densitat
fragments.text: Take its density.

fragments.title: Distribució
fragments.text: Take how elements are distributed.

fragments.title: Només com a guia visual
fragments.text: Use it only as a general visual guide, without taking any specific attribute.

fragments.title: Marc de les indicacions
fragments.text: Additional notes from the user. They refine the selections above but never override the corporate rules or the final control:

fragments.title: Control final
fragments.text: Final check before returning the image. Resolve any conflict with this priority: explicit user instruction, architectural fidelity, camera and framing, materials, logos and brands, form selections, project type preset, photographic style; no instruction may override the corporate rules. The output must have the same framing and aspect ratio as the base image. Architecture, volumes, openings, roof, structure, urban layout, camera and perspective must be identical to the base image. Logos, signs and lettering must be pixel-faithful. Do not add text, watermarks, people, vehicles or new buildings. If a requested improvement conflicts with any of these rules, skip that improvement.

fragments.title: Fase 1
fragments.text: In this pass, keep the vegetation as it is; it will be improved in a separate pass.

fragments.title: Fase 2
fragments.text: This pass edits only the vegetation. Do not touch architecture, paving, logos, glazing, buildings, roads or any other non-vegetation pixel.

fragments.title: Abast de la correcció
fragments.text: This is a correction of an existing version. Change only what is listed below and leave every other pixel of the image unchanged.

fragments.title: Vegetació poc realista
fragments.text: Make the vegetation more realistic: natural foliage, real trunks and branching, no CGI look.

fragments.title: Arbres deformats
fragments.text: Fix deformed trees: coherent trunks, natural branching and realistic crowns, keeping their positions and sizes.

fragments.title: Falta nitidesa
fragments.text: Increase sharpness and fine detail without halos, noise or oversharpening.

fragments.title: Vidres massa clars
fragments.text: Make the glazing slightly darker and more realistic.

fragments.title: Vidres massa foscos
fragments.text: Make the glazing slightly lighter and more transparent, keeping natural reflections.

fragments.title: Massa llum
fragments.text: Reduce overall exposure and blown highlights, recovering detail in bright areas.

fragments.title: Massa fosc
fragments.text: Increase overall exposure and lift shadows, recovering detail in dark areas without flattening contrast.

fragments.title: Materials poc realistes
fragments.text: Make the materials more realistic: correct texture scale, natural roughness and subtle imperfections, without changing them.

fragments.title: S'ha modificat l'arquitectura
fragments.text: Restore the architecture exactly as in the original base image: geometry, volumes, openings, roof and structure.

fragments.title: S'ha modificat un logo
fragments.text: Restore every logo, sign and lettering exactly as in the original base image.

fragments.title: Recuperar perspectiva original
fragments.text: Restore the original camera position, perspective and framing of the base image.

fragments.title: Millorar només aquesta zona
fragments.text: Apply the improvement only inside the marked area and keep everything outside it unchanged.

fragments.title: Rol del sistema
fragments.text: You are the render quality assistant of Colomer-Rifà, an architecture and engineering firm based in Vic and Olot. You support an internal tool that improves architectural renders with an image-editing model. Your priorities, in order, are: fidelity to the project, visual quality, realism and, last, creativity. You never design new architecture: the tool only improves existing projects visually. You always answer with JSON that matches the schema you are given, with no extra prose.

fragments.title: Regles de fidelitat
fragments.text: Treat the base image as the single source of truth. Building geometry and volumes, windows, doors, pillars, accesses, roof, urban layout (roads, kerbs, sidewalks, parking bays, plots), camera, perspective and framing must stay identical. Logos, signs and lettering, especially those of Bonpreu, Esclat, Esclat Oil, Cupra and SEAT, are untouchable. Report any doubt instead of hiding it.

fragments.title: Anàlisi
fragments.text: Analyse the base render. Return: projectType (one of comercial, industrial, residencial, equipament, oficines, estacio-servei, concessionari, altres) with a confidence between 0 and 1; which elements are present (vegetation, glazing, logos, signs, visible interiors, people, vehicles); the camera distance of the main vegetation (foreground, midground, background); and protectedRegions: one bounding box per logo, sign or lettering, in pixel coordinates of the base image, each with a label and a brand when recognisable. Be conservative: if unsure whether something is a logo or a sign, include it.

fragments.title: Control de qualitat general
fragments.text: Compare the base image and the result. Check each item and report ok, deviation or unsure, with the affected region as a bounding box when there is a deviation: geometry, volumes, windows, doors, pillars, accesses, roof, roads, parking, logos, signs, perspective and framing. Also report whether the aspect ratio and framing match. Never mark an item ok when you cannot verify it; use unsure.

fragments.title: Control de qualitat de la vegetació
fragments.text: Inspect only the vegetation in the result, comparing it with the base image. Report each problem with a bounding box: deformed trunks, duplicated trees, artificial crowns, blurry foliage, impossible branches, trees merged with buildings, excessive noise, background vegetation too sharp, repetitive lawn, cut-off trees, and unauthorised position changes. Return an empty list when there are no problems.

fragments.title: Rol del sistema
fragments.text: You are the 3D CAD modelling specialist of Colomer-Rifà, an architecture and engineering firm. From plans, elevations, sections, topography, sketches or images you produce a structured building model as JSON that matches the schema you are given. You never write DXF or DWG. You model only what the documentation defines; you never design new architecture. Every numeric value carries its source: plan_dimension (a written dimension), plan_graphic (measured on a drawing), image_estimate (inferred from an image) or user_choice (a value the user selected). Estimated values are flagged with estimated: true.

fragments.title: Model aproximat des d'imatges
fragments.text: Mode: approximate model from images. Do not refuse the task because there are no plans. Infer the volumetry with plausible dimensions and flag every measurement as image_estimate with estimated: true. Ask a question only if an ambiguity prevents defining the main volumetry.

fragments.title: Model precís des de plànols
fragments.text: Mode: precise model from plans. A written dimension always prevails over a graphic measurement. Do not replace missing data with usual standards unless the user authorised it explicitly through a parameter (for example a chosen floor height); in that case use user_choice. Missing data must be listed, not invented.

fragments.title: Revisar la documentació
fragments.text: Mode: documentation review. Do not produce a model. Return only contradictions, ambiguities, missing data and risks, each with the affected element and the sources involved. Do not propose solutions and do not invent values.

fragments.title: Regles
fragments.text: Rules: if two sources contradict each other, do not choose; report a contradiction with the affected element, the conflicting sources and values, the impact and the information needed to resolve it. Do not regularise defined geometries: logos and modulations keep their shape, proportions and number of elements. Never reuse dimensions or coordinates from other projects. Topography and urban works are separate, editable entities. Windows, doors and curtain walls include the components defined in the documentation. Keep real coordinates when they exist and the user asked to keep them.
